jobs.title: Data Analyst I
jobs.description:
Data Analyst I 
 Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.   Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.   Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.   Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:   Why Syneos Health • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
 Primary Roles and Responsibilities 
 Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, including joins and Common Table Expressions (CTEs), for data extraction and transformation.
 Proven ability to lead client engagements and present complex findings.
 Able to work independently without the needs for close supervision and collaboratively as part of cross team efforts
 Extremely strong organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to details
 Ensure business logic and data quality checks are implemented and functioning correctly within ADF and Databricks pipelines.
 Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
 Ensure timely data delivery by tracking system performance and proactively addressing issues within defined SLAs.
 Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to support operational and analytical data needs.
 Maintain strong documentation practices to ensure continuity and clarity across the team.
 Work closely with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and understand release processes (Dev to Ops Handover) and have experience on release management.
 Understand data integrations with third-party platforms such as Veeva CRM and Salesforce .
 Provide support during shift hours as per business requirements in EST time zones.
 Communicate effectively within team and across departments to align on objectives and tasks.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: - 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
 2–4 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, or ETL processes.
 Must hold an Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification.
 Databricks certifications are highly desirable.
 Experience with root cause analysis and troubleshooting in production environments
 Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills 
 
 Technical Skills: - 
 Primary Skills: Azure Data Factory
 Azure Databricks
 Azure Logic Apps
 Azure Data Lake Gen2(ADLS)
 SQL
 Python/PySpark
 
 Secondary Skills: - Unity Catalog
 Lakehouse Architecture
 
 Nice to Have: - Salesforce
 JIRA
 Azure Key Vault
 Azure Automation Account
 
 
 
 Get to know Syneos Health 
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000 Trial patients.
 
 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
 
 http://www.syneoshealth.com 
 
 Additional Information 
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive.  The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description.  The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above.   Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract.  Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms.  Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees.  The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist (Senior IT Analyst)
jobs.description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.    
   
 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration.   If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.   
 
 
 About you and this role 
 
 As an Implementation (Senior IT Anal yst) , you will support end-to-end implementations and deployments across software, infrastructure, digital transformation , and mergers, acquisitions , and divestiture projects . You will help ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and adopted smoothly by the organization. Working as part of an implementation team, you will manage the deployment of complex software or technical solutions for enterprise clients. Key responsibilities include leading implementation projects, configuring systems, managing data migration, directing testing activities , coordinating cross-functional teams, and training users to enable a seamless transition and faster time-to-value .   
   You are responsible for applying technical expertise , established best practices, and sound judgment to analyze and resolve problems. Your performance directly influences the quality of your work and your team’s outcomes and requires adherence to established guidelines and policies.   
   
 This role requires an understanding of the key business drivers within your discipline and function , along with the ability to expand both conceptual and practical knowledge in your area of expertise. You are expected to provide informal guidance to new team members and clearly explain complex information to.. 
 Responsibilities 
 Project Delivery: Drive or support end-to-end enterprise infrastructure or software deployments from kickoff to launch.   
 
 Configure Technical Solutions: Sets up advanced platform capabilities, including integrations, security requirements , data mapping, and configurations tailored to client needs.   
 
 Data Migration : Oversee the secure extraction, transformation, and loading of client data.   
 
 Manage Enterprise Clients: Act as the primary technical advisor for high-value corporate stakeholders.   
 
 Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting: Leads product test and user acceptance testing (UAT), identifies root causes for integration defects, and resolves production blockers.   
 
 Stakeholder Management: Communicates project status, timelines, and potential roadblocks to both internal executives and client stakeholders.   
 
 Standardize Operational Playbooks: Build reusable implementation templates to accelerate customer time-to-value.   
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor s degree in IT discipline preferred or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. 
 
 Excellent communication skills to explain complex concepts and build consensus.   
 Good to have experience into HP ALM. 
 
 Your Skill s 
 Analytical & Problem -Solving: Ability to analyze error trends, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend effective long-term fixes.   
 
 Communication: Exceptional capability to translate highly technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and business users.   
 
 Technical Proficiency: Excellent understanding & practical knowledge of IT Infrastructure, operating systems, networking, integrations , application development etc. .   
 
 Project Management: Ability to coordinate software implementations, upgrades, and testing phases with minimal supervision.   
 
 Additional notes 
 No relocation support is provided on the role.   
 
 
 
 
 
 Benefits – What Dow offers you  
 
 We invest in you.   
 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.   
 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: 
 Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 
 Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 
 Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.  Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
 
 Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
 
 Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
 Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 
 Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 
 Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
 Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).   
 Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.  
 Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 
 Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
 On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
 Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
 Additionally, some of our locations might offer: Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
 Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
 Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)
 
 
 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
 
 About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd 
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
 
 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
 
 
 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment .  We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow s equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com .

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
 Title : Senior Technical Analyst (Go-To-Market and AI Technologies) (Salesforce/Azure) 
 Education Requirements: 
 Minimum 4 Year / Bachelor s degree in computer science, information 
 technology, engineering, or related field. 
 Experience : 
 5 years of experience in enterprise application engineering, solution architecture, technical leadership, or related technology roles. 
 2 years designing and delivering AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions, including production implementations rather than prototypes alone. 
 Experience leading architecture, solution design, development, testing, deployment, integration, and ongoing support across multiple products. 
 Experience delivering technology supporting sales, marketing, and deal-management processes, including: 
 
 Prospecting, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline, and forecasting. 
 Campaigns, account-based marketing, lead management, digital engagement, and attribution. 
 Proposals, RFPs, pricing, approvals, contracting, and document generation. 
 
 
 Strong experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM, including platform architecture, security, automation, data models, APIs, and integrations. 
 Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot/Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, or comparable technologies. 
 Experience integrating CRM, customer-data platforms, data lakes, content repositories, marketing platforms, sales-enablement tools, and deal-management systems. 
 Experience leading internal engineers, external partners, and multidisciplinary delivery teams. 
 Demonstrated success modernizing platforms, reducing technical debt, improving reliability, and transitioning solutions into sustainable operational support. 
 Experience operating in a complex, global, or regulated enterprise environment is preferred. 
 
 AI Skills Deep understanding of generative AI architecture, including large language models, agentic workflows, model orchestration, tool calling, and multi-agent patterns. 
 Experience designing retrieval-augmented generation solutions using structured and unstructured enterprise data. 
 Knowledge of document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, metadata, and enterprise knowledge management. 
 Ability to determine when to use prompting, retrieval, deterministic automation, predictive models, shared agents, or end-to-end AI solutions. 
 Experience with prompt design, reusable prompt templates, grounding, context management, and response-quality optimization. 
 Ability to design AI evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, relevance, completeness, groundedness, hallucination, latency, cost, and user acceptance. 
 Experience implementing human-in-the-loop controls, confidence thresholds, citations, approvals, and exception-handling processes. 
 Strong knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, intellectual-property protection, model risk, data security, and regulatory controls. 
 Experience monitoring production AI solutions for quality, drift, usage, performance, cost, and unintended outcomes. 
 Understanding of model selection and the tradeoffs among commercial models, open models, platform-native AI, and custom development. 
 Ability to design reusable AI services and patterns that can support multiple GTM products and avoid unnecessary duplication. 
 
 Technical Skills Strong solution- and integration-architecture skills, including APIs, event-driven patterns, middleware, authentication, authorization, and identity management. 
 Strong understanding of data architecture, master data, data quality, lineage, metadata, and governance. 
 Experience with cloud architecture, software engineering standards, source control, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management. 
 Ability to establish nonfunctional requirements for security, scalability, availability, maintainability, performance, and disaster recovery. 
 Experience diagnosing complex production issues and establishing monitoring, incident-management, and support processes. 
 Ability to evaluate configuration, custom development, platform capabilities, and third-party products and recommend the appropriate approach. 
 Working knowledge of Agile delivery and product development lifecycle practices. 
 Ability to translate product roadmaps and business outcomes into technical strategies, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and engineering backlogs. 
 Strong technical leadership, including design reviews, engineering standards, mentoring, quality oversight, and resolution of cross-platform dependencies. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers while maintaining clear accountability: product leaders define the business outcomes and priorities; the technical lead owns how solutions are designed, built, operated, and evolved. 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI and architecture decisions to business and executive audiences. 
 Ability to influence Sales, Marketing, Deal Management, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders. 
 Strong vendor and implementation-partner management skills. 
 Ability to balance delivery speed with scalability, security, user experience, cost, and long-term maintainability.

jobs.description:
Job Summary 
Are you a strategic thinker with deep expertise in data architecture and analytics? Join us as a Senior Analyst, Data Analytics and lead the transformation of our global data ecosystem. 
 
 IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
 As part of our Global Business Services (GBS) team, we focus on enabling operational excellence through data, technology, and continuous improvement.
 This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Join a visionary, technically driven team where your leadership will shape the future of data analytics. Your expertise will help build the data foundations that drive smarter decisions and unlock business value across functions.
 Where You’ll Make a Difference 
 Design and implement enterprise‑scale data pipelines and advanced analytics dashboards, including solutions powered by advanced analytics Copilot Agents or Claude. 
 Develop and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and modelling workflows across structured and cloud‑based systems. 
 Build and implement best‑practice solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Power BI to deliver scalable, secure, and high‑performance data products. 
 Collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to translate complex business and finance requirements—including OTC, STP, and RTR—into actionable data strategies enhanced by AI‑driven insights from Copilot Agents or Claude. 
 Develop robust, governed Power BI datasets and dashboards that enable self‑service analytics across the organization. 
 Implement and maintain data governance, data quality, and compliance standards across analytics initiatives. 
 Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by sharing expertise, promoting best practices, and supporting the growth of data engineering capabilities within the team. 
 What Makes You the Right Fit 
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, with 5 years of experience in data analytics. 
 Expert‑level proficiency in SQL and relational database technologies. 
 Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, plus familiarity with advanced analytics Copilot Agents or Claude for accelerating insight generation. 
 Proven track record designing, building, and scaling cloud‑based data pipelines and analytics platforms. 
 Solid understanding of finance process domains such as Order to Cash (OTC), Source‑to‑Pay (STP), and Record to Report (RTR). 
 Deep understanding of data modelling, orchestration, governance, and performance optimization. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non‑technical audiences. 
 Comfortable working in fast‑paced, global environments and delivering high‑impact data solutions enhanced by AI‑powered analytics tools like Copilot Agents or Claude . 
 How Would You Stand Out 
 Experience with enterprise‑grade data orchestration tools, including Snowflake’s orchestration capabilities. 
 Proficiency in Python, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI for advanced data gathering, transformation, automation, and visualization, along with familiarity with agile development, CI/CD pipelines, and Git. 
 Strategic mindset with curiosity for emerging technologies and a passion for driving business value through data.

 Two-way transportation. 
 Learning and development programs.
